description.value: A well-maintained private RV park at the entrance to Buntzen Lake, offering showers, laundry, and flush toilets with easy access to lake swimming and surrounding hiking trails; sites are full-hookup RV-oriented at $85+/night with no tent-only rate listed.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully accessible and provides strong evidence for most amenities. The campsite info page explicitly lists 'Water on site', 'Showers', 'Laundry Facilities', and 'Convenience Store close by', while the reservation system confirms online bookings are accepted. OSM tags (power_supply=yes, sanitary_dump_station=yes) align with the website's '30 or 50 Amp Power' and 'Sewer on site' listings. No cyclist-specific amenities (hiker/biker sites, pump, tools, e-bike charging) are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM community field is 'North Vancouver' but the physical address is in Anmore, B.C. — a separate municipality near Port Moody; may cause mislocation in directory filtering.
OSM name is 'Anmore Camp & RV Park' but the website consistently uses 'Anmore Camp & R.V. Park' (with periods); OSM value retained per schema rules.
OSM record has no phone or address fields; both values sourced from website only, so contact_confirmed.phone and contact_confirmed.address are null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate, actively operating campground with on-site showers, laundry, and water adjacent to a major trail network — a useful overnight stop for touring cyclists in the Metro Vancouver east corridor.
enrichment_extras.notes: Park is primarily an RV/caravan facility; no hiker-biker walk-in sites or cyclist-specific amenities are advertised. The 30/50 Amp electrical hookups serve RV sites and are not described as available for standalone device or e-bike charging.

wow_evidence: showers, laundry, and flush toilets with easy access to lake swimming
